text.tspan: PlasRisk: a data-driven risk assessment of bacterial plasmids for One Health surveillance
Any FASTA — plasmids, draft genomes, metagenomes, contigs — ten biology-driven sub-scores with consensus weights, validated in held-out real-world cohorts
Each PSC → vector of 10 bounded scores
identical for train, test and external sets
• Ordinal mode returns the PIPdb index
BMG load adds signal beyond ARGs
